{{Top|Enemy|Grineer|Grineer|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Built by the Grineer for their elite troops, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.}} The '''Vulkar''' is a [[Grineer]] sniper rifle used by Grineer [[Ballista]]s and sometimes used by [[Warden|Grineer Wardens]]. It mainly utilizes {{D|Impact}} damage and has a very high [[status chance]], making a fair amount of shots inflict status procs. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage. *Three zoom modes: **First zoom has 2.5x zoom distance and +35% headshot damage. **Second zoom has 4.0x zoom distance and +55% headshot damage. **Third zoom has 8.0x zoom distance and +70% headshot damage. *[[Stagger]]s most enemies with every hit. *Can use the Vulkar-exclusive {{M|Lasting Purity}} and {{M|Meticulous Aim}} mods. **[[Purity]] effect from {{M|Lasting Purity}} can cause a screen shake, disrupting aiming. {{Advantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Low [[recoil]]. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]] while [[zoom]]ed in; shots will hit exactly on the reticle dot, perfect for [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]]. *Innate 1 meter [[punch through]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Sniper Rifle| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 400m to 600m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Inaccurate when fired from the hip, bullets may widely spread when fired. }} {{WeaponComparison|Vulkar Wraith}} ==Acquisition== The Vulkar's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the [[Mars]] to [[Ceres]] [[Junction]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *The Vulkar has the second longest shot combo reset time of the sniper rifles at 5 seconds, thus it can maintain its shot combo after reloading. **It needs only 2 shots to initiate the shot combo counter's 1.5x damage bonus, allowing it to attain 2.0x bonus damage if all rounds of its magazine hit. *The Vulkar, alongside the {{Weapon|Snipetron}}, has the smallest minimum zoom magnification of the sniper rifles, with its minimum zoom having only 2.5x magnification. This makes the Vulkar more effective at shooting at closer range than other sniper rifles. ==Tips== *Use a short-ranged sidearm to compensate for closer targets. *Try to aim for the head or other vulnerable points, take your time. Spraying and praying with this weapon does not work well, as with all snipers. *Adding a maxed rank {{M|Wildfire}} will give the Vulkar 1 extra bullet, while a maxed rank {{M|Magazine Warp}} will add 2 extra shots. A maxed {{M|Tainted Mag}} will add 4 shots, and all of these mods will total up in a magazine capacity of 13. *Maxed {{M|Point Strike}} and {{M|Vital Sense}} mods work well with this weapon because of its good [[critical chance]] and damage. *Use the {{M|Sniper Ammo Mutation}} mod to greatly relieve the low total ammo or {{M|Sniper Scavenger}} to increase the amount of sniper rifle ammo picked up. Bring along [[Squad Ammo Restore]]s or use Carrier's [[Ammo Case]]. *{{M|Rupture}} or {{M|Crash Course}} are the most effective physical mods to use, as they increase Vulkar's already decent {{D|Impact}} damage further. In combination they will grant a total of +210% {{D|Impact}} damage. *{{M|Heavy Caliber}} can be used on the Vulkar with little noticeable effect on its long-range accuracy, as its slow rate of fire ensures that its shots will always land on its crosshair. Heavy Caliber will affect the spread of additional bullets created by {{M|Split Chamber}} however. ==Trivia== *It seems the Vulkar's name is based on "''Vulcan''", the god of fire, the forge, and the volcanoes in Roman mythology. ==Media== File:Vulkar 1.png|Vulkar, as displayed in the arsenal File:Vulkar 3.png File:Vulkar 2.png Frontshoppgvulkar.jpg Vulkar scope overlay.png|Vulkar scope overlay {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|8wUtPwsV0C0|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|fXqFDA2ksZI|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|BoT1gPJVbI4|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|35.5}} *Fixed the Vulkar (base and Wraith) being misaligned in Warframe's supporting hand (left), causing the fingers to clip through the body of the weapon. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Vulkar {{ver|31.1}} *Converted the following weapons when used by enemies to PBR: **Vulkar {{ver|25.7}} *Converted materials to PBR on the Vulkar {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 0 to 3 {{ver|22.0.6}} *Reduced the headshot damage of the Vulkar series in '''Conclave'''. {{ver|Plains of Eidolon}} '''General Sniper Changes:''' *Reticle sway removed from all zoom levels! *1 meter punch through added to all snipers without any to start with (snipers with innate punch through unchanged). *1 combo count removed at a time when duration runs out instead of all of them (decay vs. cooldown). *1 combo count removed on miss instead of all of them *Additional bullets from multishot will each count as their own hits and misses in the combo counter *Combo duration reduced to 2 seconds for all snipers apart from Lanka which is reduced to 6 *Damage fall off begins at 400 meters and ends at 600 meters with damage reduced to 50% past 600 meters. '''Specific Sniper Weapon Changes: Vulkar''' *First level zoom +15% Damage replaced with +35% Head Shot Damage *Second level zoom 15% Damage replaced with +55% Head Shot Damage *Second level zoom reduced from 6x to 4x *Third level zoom 20% Damage replaced with +70% Head Shot Damage *Third level zoom reduced from 12x to 8x {{ver|19.6}} *Vulkar is now usable in Conclave! {{ver|The Index Preview}} *Visually updated the Vulkar Sniper scope. {{ver|15}} *'''Augment''': Vulkar: Lasting Purity: Adds 15% dead aim. {{ver|14.2}} *'''Weapon Balance Changes''': Vulkar: Damage increased from 145 to 200. Clip size increased from 4 to 6. Critical multliplier increased from 1.5x to 2.0x. Reload time reduced from 4 to 3 seconds. {{ver|12}} *Vulkar now has increased damage and proc chance. {{ver|9.5}} *Vulkar Desert Tactics Skin has been added to the market. {{ver|8.3.1|fix}} *The Vulkar Deal Pack has been added to the market. {{ver|8}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *[[Ballista]]s, the Grineer sniper units that use this weapon *[[Warden|Grineer Wardens]], a Warden that has a chance to use this weapon. *{{M|Lasting Purity}}, a Vulkar exclusive [[Syndicate]] mod. *[[Vulkar Deal Pack]], a removed bundle featuring the Vulkar exclusively. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Vulkar]] [[es:Vulkar]] [[fr:Vulkar]] [[ru:Вулкар]] [[Category:Grineer]] [[Category:Sniper Rifle]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Update 8]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Impact Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Augmented Weapons]] [[Category:Semi-Automatic]] [[uk:Вулкар]]

'''Vile Precision''' is a [[Corrupted Mod]] that decreases [[recoil|weapon recoil]] by -15% per rank and [[fire rate]] by -6% per rank of primary weapons for a maximum of -90% [[recoil|weapon recoil]] and -36% [[fire rate]] at Rank 5.

! [[recoil|Weapon Recoil]]

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*This mod can also be stacked with {{M|Stabilizer}} and {{M|Gun Glide}}, which will provide a combined recoil reduction of -170%. Any recoil reduction in excess of -100% will have no effect. 
*Due to the lower fire rate, the added recoil reduction may be redundant. Not recommended for weapons like the {{Weapon|Latron}}, for this reason.
*Can be used with high fire rate primaries, such as the {{Weapon|Grakata}}, to reduce fire rate for lower ammo consumption while also taming the weapon's recoil. Due to the lowered fire rate, however, equipping this mod will result in lowered DPS.
*On weapons without recoil, this mod will only reduce their fire rate.
*This mod at max rank does not affect the {{Weapon|Vectis}} or {{Weapon|Vectis Prime}}'s fire rate, though both still benefit from the recoil reduction.

'''Vicious Spread''' is a [[Corrupted Mod]] which increases the [[damage]] by +15% per rank, but also increases the [[Accuracy#Spread (Deviation_With Aim and Max Deviation)|spread]] of [[:Category:Shotgun|shotguns]] by +10% per rank, to a maximum of +90% and +60% at Rank 5, respectively.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*Damage bonus stacks additively with similar mods, such as {{M|Point Blank}}.
*Spread increase is additive with bonuses that increase accuracy, such as {{M|Soft Hands}}, {{M|Narrow Barrel}}, and {{M|Tainted Shell}}.
**Additional spread modifiers are <u>not</u> affected by bonuses that increase accuracy.
***For example, a {{Weapon|Arca Plasmor}} with {{M|Vicious Spread}} and {{M|Tainted Shell}} will have a max deviation of {{Math|{{Tooltip|16|Arca Plasmor's Max Deviation}} {{mul}} (1 + {{M|Vicious Spread|60%}} - {{M|Tainted Shell|77%}}) + {{M|Vicious Spread|30}}|t=y|bf=y|round=0.1}} degrees.

==Tips==
*As Vicious Spread affects the angle of a shotgun's conical spread, players can compensate by simply closing in and firing the weapon at almost point blank range to ensure all shots hit the target.
*Not recommended to be combined with {{M|Galvanized Acceleration}}, as the spread will be bigger at the bonus effective range and thus will cause more shots to miss enemies at long range, unless combined with [[Punch Through]] mods if the intention is to make the shotgun good at large crowd control.

==Notes==

*The damage reduction is additive. For example, a weapon equipped with maxed {{M|Serration}} and Vile Acceleration would deal 250% of its base damage.
**Compared to only a maxed rank Serration, adding a Vile Acceleration represents a loss of only 5.6% damage.
*With a max ranked Serration (but without {{M|Heavy Caliber}}), this represents a DPS upgrade over Speed Trigger of about 12% on fully automatic weapons that can take full advantage of the fire rate increase. It does still lead to greater ammo consumption and more frequent reloads though, so keep that in mind when modding your weapon.

{{Codex|Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.}}

The '''Veldt''' is a [[Tenno]] semi-automatic revolver rifle sporting high damage and accuracy, but has a fairly poor fire rate. It also possesses an adjustable [[zoom]] via [[Alternate Fire]] while aiming.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals {{D|Slash}} damage.
*While aiming, [[Alternate Fire]] adjusts the [[zoom]], allowing players to deal with enemies at close and medium ranges.
*Innate {{Pol|Naramon}} polarity.
*Has uniform [[spread]] while hip-firing and while scoped, meaning that shots will not stray above or below the reticle.

{{Advantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Semi-Auto|}}
{{Disadvantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Semi-Auto|}}

==Acquisition==
The Veldt's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*While aiming, players can increase or decrease the zoom using [[Alternate Fire]].
*The pitch of the shots changes on the last 4 rounds.
*Unlike most other weapons that have variable zoom modes, (usually auto to semi) the stats of the weapon stay the same, neither punishing nor enhancing the weapon. This means players can choose to have low or high zoom, without suffering any negative (or positive) stat changes in doing so.

==Tips==
*Considering the weapon's alternative fire mode, {{M|Eagle Eye}} can be used to emulate sniper-grade scope amplification, excluding the scope reticle UI.

==Trivia==
*A ''[[Wikipedia:Veld|Veldt]]'' is a thinly forested region typical to the southern part of Africa.
*The Veldt shares several similarities with old big game rifles, including the large and ornate trigger guard and hammer, and the full-length rifle "scope".
*The Veldt was an offshoot of the {{Weapon|Tenora}}'s design process, which itself came from the {{Weapon|Pandero}}'s design process.

{{Codex|A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering. Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.}}{{For|the [[Orphix]] mission on [[Venus]] in [[Empyrean]]|Vesper Strait}}
The '''Vesper 77''' is a 1999 semi-automatic pistol with extreme [[accuracy]] and an included [[Silent|suppressor]]. [[Zoom|Aiming]] activates the laser sight to highlight [[Enemy Body Parts|weak points]] with increased [[critical multiplier]].

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*[[Zoom|Aiming]] highlights [[Enemy Body Parts|weak points]] indicated by crosshairs and grants '''+40%''' [[Critical Damage]].
**The color of the targeting reticle that appears on enemy head/weakspots is dictated by the energy color of the weapon.
*Can use the Vesper 77-exclusive {{M|Leaded Gas}} mod.

{{Advantages|
*[[Silent]].}}
{{Disadvantages}}

{{Acquisition|Vesper 77's main blueprint is awarded from Tier 4 [[Höllvania Central Mall]] [[Bounty|Bounties]] as a rare drop, requiring the completion of [[The Hex (Quest)|The Hex]] to access. The Barrel, Receiver, and Handle are awarded from [[Höllvania]] [[Legacyte Harvest]] and [[Hell-Scrub]].

Alternatively Vesper 77's blueprints can be purchased from [[Amir]] of {{Faction|The Hex}} for {{sc|Standing}}; component blueprints for {{sc|5,000}} and the main blueprint for {{sc|15,000}}, all requiring '''Rank 3 - 2-For-1'''.}}
{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

== Trivia ==
*The Vesper 77 is based on the Polish [https://www.forgottenweapons.com/pt83-the-sneaky-silenced-version-of-polands-p83-pistol/ PT83], derived from the [[:wikipedia:FB_P-83_Wanad|P-83 Wanad]], or the Russian [[:wikipedia:PB (pistol)|PB]], that has a fixed suppressor for the barrel and is designed so that the slide will remain closed when firing, necessitating manual racking of the slide to eject the casing.
** Key deviations from the real-world design include a fully-reciprocating slide, an underbarrel mounting point for the laser sight, more modern materials, and a general increase in size so as to fit at the scale of Warframes.
*The Höllvanian text on the right reads "OoRNIhNg MAeH FAyeHEhR OoHEhN UhNLOhDOhD" (Warning may fire when unloaded) and ".45 KAhL" (.45 Cal). The text on the left side reads "PAhTUhNTEhD SehP 12 1966, NOhV 4 1968, PR 15 1976" (Patented Sep 12 1966, Nov 4 1968, Apr 15 1976), "EhN 17 0451" (N 17 0451), and "VEhSPEhR MAwDUhL 77" (Vesper Model 77).
